public_view.claim: Unlabeled density-view consistency can safely update cross-modal LayerNorm affine parameters; pilot feasibility only
public_view.not_claimed: source-only cross-platform transfer; population generalization; full official benchmark replication
public_view.cohort: SHA256 order one frame per validation scene, at most4/platform, first caption per frame; available Waymo4 Drone2 Quad3=9
public_view.optimizer: Adam, new optimizer per sample and arm
public_view.parameters: affine weights and bias of LayerNorm modules under cross_encoder only; exact names saved before adaptation
public_view.frozen: visual/audio(not applicable)/text backbones; all other parameters; all BatchNorm running stats; eval-mode Dropout
public_view.view: remove10% unique xyz locations from baseline16384 input, then repeat retained unique coordinates to16384; no coordinate transform
public_view.teacher: frozen original+sparse predictions, boxes matched by Hungarian center+size distance normalized by median box size
public_view.target: softmax((original noun score+matched sparse noun score)/2/0.1)

losses.gated: same KL, accept only original vs sparse top box axis IoU>=0.25

public_view.reset: before and finally after each arm restore LN weights, gradients, torchCPU/CUDA RNG; model eval; verify source repeat <=1e-5

preprocessing.waymo: official front-view yaw rotation based lidar view id; no translation
preprocessing.color: not used; official loader returns xyz even use_color true

public_view.readout: first object-word match from fixed text-only lexicon, all-text fallback. Does not use target class annotations. Different from official target-span readout

scoring.primary: full Rz(yaw)@Ry(pitch)@Rx(roll) GT vs axis-aligned predicted box exact convex volume IoU; first query; mean/Acc>.25/Acc>.5
scoring.comparisons: native official yaw-only loader IoU and independently exact yaw-only IoU; target-class-assisted noun readout diagnostic separately
scoring.labels: GT accessed only by independent CPU scorer after predictions and plan sealed
scoring.tails: retain each paired sample, rescue/harm, no tuning on scored pilot
scoring.cost: per sample elapsed seconds and peak allocated GPU bytes; excludes downloads/compilation

public_view.resource_limit: single GPU serial granted by parent;9fixed samples;3steps;40GB initial disk
public_view.amendment: Before task prediction: initialize RoBERTa architecture from official local config; then strict-load complete official3EED checkpoint including all frozen text_encoder tensors. Explicitly error if text embedding absent or any missing/unexpected key. Avoid redundant pretrained encoder download, no random fallback. Default upstream constructor unchanged unless explicit config-only argument.

redactions: Local workspace prefix replaced. Relative selected dataset paths hashed; exact hashed frame IDs and deterministic selection algorithms in result records permit reconstruction from official dataset.
